verses.ar: «لِأَنَّهُ يُوجَدُ لِلْفِضَّةِ مَعْدَنٌ، وَمَوْضِعٌ لِلذَّهَبِ حَيْثُ يُمَحِّصُونَهُ.
verses.kjv: Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold [where] they fine [it].
verses.web: “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.
verses.he: כִּ֤י יֵ֣שׁ לַכֶּ֣סֶף מֹוצָ֑א וּ֝מָקֹ֗ום לַזָּהָ֥ב יָזֹֽקּוּ׃

verses.ar: ٱلْحَدِيدُ يُسْتَخْرَجُ مِنَ ٱلتُّرَابِ، وَٱلْحَجَرُ يَسْكُبُ نُحَاسًا.
verses.kjv: Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass [is] molten [out of] the stone.
verses.web: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.
verses.he: בַּ֭רְזֶל מֵעָפָ֣ר יֻקָּ֑ח וְ֝אֶ֗בֶן יָצ֥וּק נְחוּשָֽׁה׃

verses.ar: قَدْ جَعَلَ لِلظُّلْمَةِ نَهَايَةً، وَإِلَى كُلِّ طَرَفٍ هُوَ يَفْحَصُ. حَجَرَ ٱلظُّلْمَةِ وَظِلَّ ٱلْمَوْتِ.
verses.kjv: He setteth an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.
verses.web: Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.
verses.he: קֵ֤ץ ׀ שָׂ֤ם לַחֹ֗שֶׁךְ וּֽלְכָל־תַּ֭כְלִית ה֣וּא חֹוקֵ֑ר אֶ֖בֶן אֹ֣פֶל וְצַלְמָֽוֶת׃

verses.ar: حَفَرَ مَنْجَمًا بَعِيدًا عَنِ ٱلسُّكَّانِ. بِلَا مَوْطِئٍ لِلْقَدَمِ، مُتَدَلِّينَ بَعِيدِينَ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ يَتَدَلْدَلُونَ.
verses.kjv: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; [even the waters] forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.
verses.web: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.
verses.he: פָּ֤רַץ נַ֨חַל ׀ מֵֽעִם־גָּ֗ר הַֽנִּשְׁכָּחִ֥ים מִנִּי־רָ֑גֶל דַּ֖לּוּ מֵאֱנֹ֣ושׁ נָֽעוּ׃

verses.ar: أَرْضٌ يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا ٱلْخُبْزُ، أَسْفَلُهَا يَنْقَلِبُ كَمَا بِٱلنَّارِ.
verses.kjv: [As for] the earth, out of it cometh bread: and under it is turned up as it were fire.
verses.web: As for the earth, out of it comes bread. Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.
verses.he: אֶ֗רֶץ מִמֶּ֥נָּה יֵֽצֵא־לָ֑חֶם וְ֝תַחְתֶּ֗יהָ נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ כְּמֹו־אֵֽשׁ׃

verses.ar: حِجَارَتُهَا هِيَ مَوْضِعُ ٱلْيَاقُوتِ ٱلْأَزْرَقِ، وَفِيهَا تُرَابُ ٱلذَّهَبِ.
verses.kjv: The stones of it [are] the place of sapphires: and it hath dust of gold.
verses.web: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.
verses.he: מְקֹום־סַפִּ֥יר אֲבָנֶ֑יהָ וְעַפְרֹ֖ת זָהָ֣ב לֹֽו׃

verses.ar: سَبِيلٌ لَمْ يَعْرِفْهُ كَاسِرٌ، وَلَمْ تُبْصِرْهُ عَيْنُ بَاشِقٍ،
verses.kjv: [There is] a path which no fowl knoweth, and which the vulture’s eye hath not seen:
verses.web: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.
verses.he: נָ֭תִיב לֹֽא־יְדָ֣עֹו עָ֑יִט וְלֹ֥א שְׁ֝זָפַ֗תּוּ עֵ֣ין אַיָּֽה׃

verses.ar: وَلَمْ تَدُسْهُ أَجْرَاءُ ٱلسَّبْعِ، وَلَمْ يَعْدُهُ ٱلزَّائِرُ.
verses.kjv: The lion’s whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.
verses.web: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.
verses.he: לֹֽא־הִדְרִיכֻ֥הוּ בְנֵי־שָׁ֑חַץ לֹֽא־עָדָ֖ה עָלָ֣יו שָֽׁחַל׃

verses.ar: إِلَى ٱلصَّوَّانِ يَمُدُّ يَدَهُ. يَقْلِبُ ٱلْجِبَالَ مِنْ أُصُولِهَا.
verses.kjv: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth the mountains by the roots.
verses.web: He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.
verses.he: בַּֽ֭חַלָּמִישׁ שָׁלַ֣ח יָדֹ֑ו הָפַ֖ךְ מִשֹּׁ֣רֶשׁ הָרִֽים׃

verses.ar: يَنْقُرُ فِي ٱلصُّخُورِ سَرَبًا، وَعَيْنُهُ تَرَى كُلَّ ثَمِينٍ.
verses.kjv: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and his eye seeth every precious thing.
verses.web: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.
verses.he: בַּ֭צּוּרֹות יְאֹרִ֣ים בִּקֵּ֑עַ וְכָל־יְ֝קָ֗ר רָאֲתָ֥ה עֵינֹֽו׃

verses.ar: يَمْنَعُ رَشْحَ ٱلْأَنْهَارِ، وَأَبْرَزَ ٱلْخَفِيَّاتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ.
verses.kjv: He bindeth the floods from overflowing; and [the thing that is] hid bringeth he forth to light.
verses.web: He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings out to light.
verses.he: מִ֭בְּכִי נְהָרֹ֣ות חִבֵּ֑שׁ וְ֝תַעֲלֻמָ֗הּ יֹ֣צִא אֹֽור׃ פ

verses.ar: «أَمَّا ٱلْحِكْمَةُ فَمِنْ أَيْنَ تُوجَدُ، وَأَيْنَ هُوَ مَكَانُ ٱلْفَهْمِ؟
verses.kjv: But where shall wisdom be found? and where [is] the place of understanding?
verses.web: “But where will wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?
verses.he: וְֽ֭הַחָכְמָה מֵאַ֣יִן תִּמָּצֵ֑א וְאֵ֥י זֶ֝ה מְקֹ֣ום בִּינָֽה׃

verses.ar: لَا يَعْرِفُ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ قِيمَتَهَا وَلَا تُوجَدُ فِي أَرْضِ ٱلْأَحْيَاءِ.
verses.kjv: Man knoweth not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living.
verses.web: Man doesn’t know its price, and it isn’t found in the land of the living.
verses.he: לֹא־יָדַ֣ע אֱנֹ֣ושׁ עֶרְכָּ֑הּ וְלֹ֥א תִ֝מָּצֵ֗א בְּאֶ֣רֶץ הֽ͏ַחַיִּֽים׃

verses.ar: ٱلْغَمْرُ يَقُولُ: لَيْسَتْ هِيَ فِيَّ، وَٱلْبَحْرُ يَقُولُ: لَيْسَتْ هِيَ عِنْدِي.
verses.kjv: The depth saith, It [is] not in me: and the sea saith, [It is] not with me.
verses.web: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’
verses.he: תְּהֹ֣ום אָ֭מַר לֹ֣א בִי־הִ֑יא וְיָ֥ם אָ֝מַ֗ר אֵ֣ין עִמָּדִֽי׃

verses.ar: لَا يُعْطَى ذَهَبٌ خَالِصٌ بَدَلَهَا، وَلَا تُوزَنُ فِضَّةٌ ثَمَنًا لَهَا.
verses.kjv: It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed [for] the price thereof.
verses.web: It can’t be gotten for gold, neither will silver be weighed for its price.
verses.he: לֹא־יֻתַּ֣ן סְגֹ֣ור תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ וְלֹ֥א יִ֝שָּׁקֵ֗ל כֶּ֣סֶף מְחִירָֽהּ׃

verses.ar: لَا تُوزَنُ بِذَهَبِ أُوفِيرَ أَوْ بِٱلْجَزْعِ ٱلْكَرِيمِ أَوِ ٱلْيَاقُوتِ ٱلْأَزْرَقِ.
verses.kjv: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
verses.web: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
verses.he: לֹֽא־תְ֭סֻלֶּה בְּכֶ֣תֶם אֹופִ֑יר בְּשֹׁ֖הַם יָקָ֣ר וְסַפִּֽיר׃

verses.ar: لَا يُعَادِلُهَا ٱلذَّهَبُ وَلَا ٱلزُّجَاجُ، وَلَا تُبْدَلُ بِإِنَاءِ ذَهَبٍ إِبْرِيزٍ.
verses.kjv: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it [shall not be for] jewels of fine gold.
verses.web: Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither will it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.
verses.he: לֹא־יַעַרְכֶ֣נָּה זָ֭הָב וּזְכֹוכִ֑ית וּתְמ֖וּרָתָ֣הּ כְּלִי־פָֽז׃

verses.ar: لَا يُذْكَرُ ٱلْمَرْجَانُ أَوِ ٱلْبَلُّوْرُ، وَتَحْصِيلُ ٱلْحِكْمَةِ خَيْرٌ مِنَ ٱللَّآلِئِ.
verses.kjv: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom [is] above rubies.
verses.web: No mention will be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.
verses.he: רָאמֹ֣ות וְ֭גָבִישׁ לֹ֣א יִזָּכֵ֑ר וּמֶ֥שֶׁךְ חָ֝כְמָ֗ה מִפְּנִינִֽים׃

verses.ar: لَا يُعَادِلُهَا يَاقُوتُ كُوشَ ٱلْأَصْفَرُ، وَلَا تُوزَنُ بِٱلذَّهَبِ ٱلْخَالِصِ.
verses.kjv: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.
verses.web: The topaz of Ethiopia will not equal it. It won’t be valued with pure gold.
verses.he: לֹֽא־יַ֭עַרְכֶנָּה פִּטְדַת־כּ֑וּשׁ בְּכֶ֥תֶם טָ֝הֹ֗ור לֹ֣א תְסֻלֶּֽה׃ פ

verses.ar: «فَمِنْ أَيْنَ تَأْتِي ٱلْحِكْمَةُ، وَأَيْنَ هُوَ مَكَانُ ٱلْفَهْمِ؟
verses.kjv: Whence then cometh wisdom? and where [is] the place of understanding?
verses.web: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?
verses.he: וְֽ֭הַחָכְמָה מֵאַ֣יִן תָּבֹ֑וא וְאֵ֥י זֶ֝֗ה מְקֹ֣ום בִּינָֽה׃

verses.ar: إِذْ أُخْفِيَتْ عَنْ عُيُونِ كُلِّ حَيٍّ، وَسُتِرَتْ عَنْ طَيْرِ ٱلسَّمَاءِ.
verses.kjv: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the fowls of the air.
verses.web: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.
verses.he: וְֽ֭נֶעֶלְמָה מֵעֵינֵ֣י כָל־חָ֑י וּמֵעֹ֖וף הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם נִסְתָּֽרָה׃

verses.ar: اَلْهَلَاكُ وَٱلْمَوْتُ يَقُولَانِ: بِآذَانِنَا قَدْ سَمِعْنَا خَبَرَهَا.
verses.kjv: Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.
verses.web: Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’
verses.he: אֲבַדֹּ֣ון וָ֭מָוֶת אָ֣מְר֑וּ בְּ֝אָזְנֵ֗ינוּ שָׁמַ֥עְנוּ שִׁמְעָֽהּ׃

verses.ar: ٱللهُ يَفْهَمُ طَرِيقَهَا، وَهُوَ عَالِمٌ بِمَكَانِهَا.
verses.kjv: God understandeth the way thereof, and he knoweth the place thereof.
verses.web: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.
verses.he: אֱ֭לֹהִים הֵבִ֣ין דַּרְכָּ֑הּ וְ֝ה֗וּא יָדַ֥ע אֶת־מְקֹומָֽהּ׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ هُوَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى أَقَاصِي ٱلْأَرْضِ. تَحْتَ كُلِّ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ يَرَى.
verses.kjv: For he looketh to the ends of the earth, [and] seeth under the whole heaven;
verses.web: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.
verses.he: כִּי־ה֖וּא לִקְצֹות־הָאָ֣רֶץ יַבִּ֑יט תַּ֖חַת כָּל־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם יִרְאֶֽה׃

verses.ar: لِيَجْعَلَ لِلرِّيحِ وَزْنًا، وَيُعَايِرَ ٱلْمِيَاهَ بِمِقْيَاسٍ.
verses.kjv: To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.
verses.web: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.
verses.he: לַעֲשֹׂ֣ות לָר֣וּחַ מִשְׁקָ֑ל וּ֝מַ֗יִם תִּכֵּ֥ן בְּמִדָּֽה׃

verses.ar: لَمَّا جَعَلَ لِلْمَطَرِ فَرِيضَةً، وَمَذْهَبًا لِلصَّوَاعِقِ،
verses.kjv: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder:
verses.web: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder,
verses.he: בַּעֲשׂתֹ֣ו לַמָּטָ֣ר חֹ֑ק וְ֝דֶ֗רֶךְ לַחֲזִ֥יז קֹלֹֽות׃

verses.ar: حِينَئِذٍ رَآهَا وَأَخْبَرَ بِهَا، هَيَّأَهَا وَأَيْضًا بَحَثَ عَنْهَا،
verses.kjv: Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out.
verses.web: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.
verses.he: אָ֣ז רָ֭אָהּ וַֽיְסַפְּרָ֑הּ הֱ֝כִינָ֗הּ וְגַם־חֲקָרָֽהּ׃

verses.ar: وَقَالَ لِلْإِنْسَانِ: هُوَذَا مَخَافَةُ ٱلرَّبِّ هِيَ ٱلْحِكْمَةُ، وَٱلْحَيَدَانُ عَنِ ٱلشَّرِّ هُوَ ٱلْفَهْمُ».
verses.kjv: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that [is] wisdom; and to depart from evil [is] understanding.
verses.web: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’”
verses.he: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר ׀ לָֽאָדָ֗ם הֵ֤ן יִרְאַ֣ת אֲ֭דֹנָי הִ֣יא חָכְמָ֑ה וְס֖וּר מֵרָ֣ע בִּינָֽה׃ ס
